name: Stein Danielsen
current_role: Co-founder and Chief Solutions Officer, Cognite (per conference bio)
profile: Stein Hardy Danielsen co-founded Norwegian industrial data/AI software company Cognite in 2016 with John Markus Lervik and Geir Engdahl. Cognite's Cognite Data Fusion platform contextualizes industrial (oil & gas, energy, manufacturing) data; he has overseen applications and solutions built on it.
interesting_fact: Before Cognite he was Chief Architect at Cxense, and earlier CEO of Kopek; his background spans search, real-time systems, 3D graphics and large-scale data/transaction systems.
deep_cut_fact: He worked in product development at FAST (Fast Search & Transfer), the Norwegian enterprise-search company, and is also listed as a principal at Microsoft; he holds an MSc in Computer Science from NTNU.
notes: Low public profile; rarely interviewed. media@cognite.com seen in Dec 2025 Cognite HQ release (page blocked direct fetch; seen via search). Cognite is industrial/energy-data focused, a good podcast fit. Some sources spell his name 'Danielson'.
